why.label: Kuki Hitamo Hollywood Hotel
why.description:
Duherereye mu Mujyi wa Rwimiyaga, Hollywood Hotel itewe ishema no kuba ari yo hoteli yambere mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba.

Duhuza ubwiza buhebuje n'ibigezweho by'akataraboneka — tubagezaho ibyumba byateguranywe ubuhanga budasanzwe, ibikorwaremezo byo ku rwego rw'isi, ndetse n'urwego rwo kwakira abashyitsi rutagereranywa. Ibi ni byo byatumye tuba amahitamo ya mbere y'abagenzi bose basura aka karere.
features: Ibyumba bisaga 100 byiza byo mu byiciro 5
Ibyumba by'inama bitatu kuri buri gikorwa — kuva ku nama z'ubuyobozi kugeza ku birori binini
Baraza Lounge & Bar ifite ibinyobwa byiza n'umuziki ushimishije
Spa, Pisine & Ikigo cy'ubuzima bwiza (Wellness Centre) byuzuye
Imodoka itwara abantu n'ahantu heza rwagati mu mujyi

accommodations.label: Aho Kurara Hacu
accommodations.title: Ibyumba
accommodations.description: Reba ibyumba byacu bihebuje, byateguranwe ubuhanga buhanitse kandi bituma ugubwa neza

featuredRooms.name: Icyumba cya Deluxe
featuredRooms.description: Ahantu hagutse heza heza ho kwicara n'ibindi byinshi byiza. Cyiza ku bashakanye n'abagenzi mu kazi.

featuredRooms.name: Hollywood Suite
featuredRooms.description: Icyumba cyacu cyihariye kifite aho kwicarira hatandukanye, ukareba umujyi wose kandi ikagira ibyiza byinshi byerekana ubwiza.

featuredRooms.name: Presidential Suite
featuredRooms.description: Icyiza kuruta ibindi. Etaje yose ifite uwukwitaho wihariye, aho kurira hanini, n'icyumba cy'ikiraro kinini cyane.

reviews.label: Uko Abashyitsi Babibona
reviews.title: Icyo Abashyitsi Bacu Bavuga
reviews.description: Inkuru zivuye mu bashyitsi babonye itandukaniro rya Hollywood Hotel.

testimonials.quote: Birashimishije cyane. Hollywood Hotel isobanura ubwiza bundi bushya — kuva mu nzu y'imbere nini kugeza ku hantu ho kuruhukira hejuru, buri kantu kanoze.
testimonials.author: Jean-Paul R.

testimonials.quote: Twakoreye ibirori byacu bya buri mwaka mu cyumba cy'inama kinini. Ikipe yari idasanzwe kandi amafunguro yari ku rwego rw'isi. Tuzagaruka buri mwaka.
testimonials.author: Marie Claire U.

testimonials.quote: Presidential Suite yari itandukanye n'ibyo nigeze mbona byose. Spa na pisine mu gitondo cyakurikiyeho byabigize byiza cyane.
testimonials.author: David K.

cta.title: Witeguye Kuba Muri Hollywood?
cta.description: Fata umwanya wawe uyu munsi winjire mu isi aho buri kantu gateguriwe kugushimisha.

conferenceSection.title: Ibyumba by'Inama n'Ibirori
conferenceSection.description: Tegurira inama cyangwa ibirori byawe mu byumba byacu by'akataraboneka kandi bigezweho. Bifite ikoranabuhanga rihanitse kugira ngo bitange umusaruro, ibyumba byacu bishobora guhindurwa bitewe n'ibyo mukeneye—yaba inama, ubukwe cyangwa ibindi birori byubwoko bwose.

wellnessSection.title: Kuruhuka
wellnessSection.description: Komeza gahunda yawe yo kwita ku buzima bwiza mu nzu yacu y'imyitozo (Gym) igezweho kandi yuzuye ibikoresho. Uhasanga ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga rigezweho byo kongera imbaraga no gutuma amaraso atembera neza

rooms.title: Ibyumba
rooms.subtitle: Amoko atanu y'ibyumba byiza cyane — kuva ku byumba bisanzwe byiza kugeza kuri Presidential Suite yacu yihariye.
rooms.standardDesc: Cyiza ku muntu umwe cg kuraramo ijoro rimwe. Gikeye, gifite amahoro n'ibikenerwa byose.
rooms.deluxeDesc: Kinini kandi cyiza kurushaho. Cyiza ku bashakanye cyangwa abanyemari bashaka ahantu hagutse ho kuruhukira.
rooms.executiveDesc: Kwiyakira byo ku rwego rwo hejuru harimo aho gukorera no kwidagadura ku munyamwuga ushaka ibirenzeho.
rooms.hollywoodDesc: Icyumba cyacu cyihariye kifite aho kwicarira hatandukanye, ukareba umujyi wose kandi ikagira ibyiza byinshi.
rooms.presidentialDesc: Icyiza kuruta ibindi muri Hollywood Hotel. Etaje yose, icyumba cy'ikiraro kinini, uwukwitaho wihariye, aho kurira wenyine, na terasi ureberaho.
